requirements.title: The account sits behind an AccountClient interface whose in-memory fake starts at a $250.00 balance, lists 8 contacts, and has a send call that can be made to fail
Typing in the contact list's search field filters the contacts by name
Tapping a contact moves to the amount screen for that contact
The keypad rejects a third digit after the decimal point and a second decimal point
The keypad never keeps a leading zero ("007" shows as "7") and delete removes the last typed character
The amount shows formatted as US-dollar currency as the user types
Continue is enabled only for an amount above $0.00 and no more than the current balance
Every money value is a Decimal, never a floating-point type
The confirmation screen shows the contact and the amount, and Send calls the account client
A successful send lowers the balance by the amount and puts the payment at the top of the first screen's activity list
A failed send leaves the balance unchanged and shows an error with a way to try again
The posts screen is replaced by the send-money home screen, and the existing APIClient and LogClient tests still pass
